{{Quote|And I went and told Harvey he was seeing things.|Amikab|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Harvey''' was a prisoner in the [[Belsavis prison]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]] he informed [[Amikab]] of seeing the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] known for besting [[Nok Drayen]], to which Amikab refused to believe. In truth, the [[Voidhound]] was indeed on Belsavis, but working with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], not as a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]].
